reserveReview.rationale: Deloitte’s unmodified AICPA examination dated August 27, 2026 covers management’s July 31, 2026 5:00pm Eastern Time assertion. The rendered page 5 table reports $1,575,160,913 of reserve market value against 1,463,694,758 outstanding RLUSD across all seven NYDFS-approved networks: Treasury bills $1,077,871,526, government money-market funds $258,192,967, and cash $239,096,420. The three asset rows sum exactly to the reported total, with $111,466,155 excess reserves. Stable row keys match the hash-bound independent-PDF producer. The report confirms Treasury bills acquired within three months of maturity; depository and money-market-fund identities remain undisclosed.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Deloitte examination of the RLUSD Reserve Report as of July 31, 2026 at 5:00pm Eastern Time
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No material asset-class exposure is unclassified; the public report does not identify the depository institutions, money market funds, or custodians.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Ripple's July 9, 2025 press release names BNY as the primary RLUSD reserve custodian, and the Deloitte report plus stablecoin terms confirm segregated reserve accounts held with NYDFS-approved U.S. depositories or custodians. Custody allocation shares, the identities of any additional depository institutions, statutory bankruptcy remoteness, and reserve-wide rehypothecation treatment remain undisclosed.
